title: Optics and photonics
introduction: Design, construction and operation of optical microscopy platforms, ranging from fluorescence microscopy to interferometric scattering microscopy, to study biological and nanoscale systems.

highlights.value: Development and deployment of algorithms enabling the complete automation of microscopy platforms.

paragraphs: My work in optics and photonics focuses on the design, construction and operation of microscopy platforms, including both the construction and calibration of optical paths and the development of the various control and analysis software applications required to operate these platforms. In particular, my work has enabled me to develop software for automating microscopy platforms.

My involvement in the design and development of microscopy platforms began during my contract in Mark I WALLACE's group, in the Department of Chemistry at King's College London, where my project involved building a custom interferometric scattering microscope (iSCAT). In addition to constructing the microscope, I was responsible for developing its control software using LabVIEW. The microscope was subsequently used for my own experimental project as well as for the projects of several employees whom I supervised.

I was also able to apply my microscopy platform development skills during a consulting assignment for Vidya Health Ltd (London, United Kingdom), where I contributed to the design and, in particular, the programming of a platform capable of automatically analysing a large number of medical samples. My work on this contract focused specifically on designing the autofocus program.
This body of work enabled me to publish a total of 3 scientific papers, including work studying the kinetics of polymerisation reactions by observing individual molecules.
